name: Self-Attenuation Integral Evaluation
aliases: Proof for Equation used for Self-Attenuation
definition: Computes the self-attenuation integral for a ray R through pixel p, where the integrand involves a normalized 3D Gaussian G_3^n and an exponential attenuation term based on the cumulative integral H(t).
summary: Self-Attenuation Integral Evaluation computes the exact closed-form volume rendering integral for 3D Gaussians, avoiding the discretization errors of discrete ray marching.
